newsitem.title: UK: CNC Properties in takeover talks.
newsitem.headline: CNC Properties in takeover talks.

text.p: Britain's CNC Properties Plc said on Wednesday it might be taken over after an interested bidder contacted it.
"The company can confirm that it has received an approach which may or may not lead to a bid," it said in a brief statement.
The property investment, trading and management company raised pre-tax profits rise 56 percent to 2.36 million stg in the year to last December.
No further details were immediately available, but the news sent the company's beleaguered shares up 5.5p to a new year high of 87p in slim trade.
